_comment: Pinned OCR asset versions + SHA256 checksums, verified at build time by desktop/build.ps1 / build.sh. URL composition mirrors cloudflared-versions.json EXACTLY: for each group the download URL is <group>.baseUrl + '/' + <group>.version + '/' + <asset> (three segments; version is a path element, NOT baked into baseUrl). 'tessdata' is required on every target. 'nativeLib' is OPTIONAL per target: Windows gets native libtesseract from the TesseractOCR NuGet payload (self-contained publish), so no nativeLib entry is needed there; Linux/macOS need a native bundle for zero-setup — add a pinned entry when available. The Linux/macOS nativeLib sha256 values below are DOCUMENTED PLACEHOLDERS (mechanism-only this iteration): populate them with real pinned release assets + hashes before relying on zero-setup native OCR on those platforms. Update deliberately: re-download over HTTPS, recompute sha256, record in docs/setup/ocr.md. The build FAILS on checksum mismatch.
